messages.body: CORRECTION to m65022: the [redacted] "blocker" was wrong. No key to wire — the OR key already lives in the gateway; abilifi-models registry serves provider:'or' models (claude-opus-4.8-fast/gemini/deepseek-r1) and the gateway holds the key (cloud-only, no raw keys in workers). self_heal (BEB-4452) calls the big model through that existing gateway. No blocker — LOOP claim 4452.

STOP — Alex 2026-08-24 REVOKED gateway use: "i dont give permission to use it for anything right now." Overrides 3854's OpenRouter authorization. DO NOT run any OR/big-model escalation. BEB-4452 (self_heal) may be BUILT but its gateway call must be permission-gated (allow flag OFF by default, currently OFF) AND must notify Alex on every call (worker+reason+red+spend). Do not test 4452 against the live gateway. self_heal auto-escalation stays dark until Alex re-permits. cf-native codegen (the normal /gen build path) is unaffected — this gate is the paid provider:'or' escalation path.
DIRECTIVE 65026 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-4452, BEB-3854 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
